verdict.rationale: iTerm2 puts generative AI in an optional plugin you must install (iterm2-docs-15), and community reports describe the feature as inactive by default (iterm2-comm-3). The built-in LLM chat only optionally reads terminal contents through explicit session linking (iterm2-gh-6). However, a user report says the earlier key-box control was not a true off switch, because any text in the API key field turned on sending data to OpenAI (iterm2-comm-2), and there is no clear documentation of what session data leaves the machine. Missing for 10: documented per-feature data-egress controls, explicit confirmation that no login or account is required, first-party documentation of a full-disable mechanism, and independent confirmation that the plugin model fixed the toggle issue.
